captions.name: hook
captions.head:
Rooftop PV design,
in your browser.
captions.sub: From a roof on the map to a complete PV design.

captions.name: c1
captions.head: Paste the coordinates.
captions.sub: Or search an address, or a maps link.

captions.name: c2
captions.head: One click detects the building.
captions.sub: The footprint from Overture Maps, with corners you can drag.

captions.name: c3
captions.head: The roof rises in 3D, laid out at once.
captions.sub: Every position to scale, clear of the parapet, the setback and the walkways.

captions.name: c4
captions.head: On the satellite imagery, to scale.
captions.sub: Obstacles with their heights, so their shadows stay off the modules.

captions.name: c5
captions.head: Shadows at any hour.
captions.sub: The sun path, the shade-free window, and shading over the year.

captions.name: c6
captions.head: Strings sized to your inverter.
captions.sub: Options compared by DC/AC, clipping and energy.

captions.name: c7
captions.head: 8,760 hours, every loss named.
captions.sub: P50 · P75 · P90 on PVGIS weather, or your own CSV.

captions.name: c8
captions.head: Report, SLD, BOM, cable schedule, DXF, KMZ.
captions.sub: And the hourly data. One by one, or in one zip.

captions.name: c9
captions.head: From a roof on the map to the energy. In minutes.

end.line: Rooftop PV design, in your browser.

_about:
The words on the screen: short, plain and direct, as the owner approved them on 2026-10-10 (a longer full-sentence set was tried and rejected: captions are read at a glance). A caption with a place is a card at that place on the wide cut (sqPlace on the square): bl, bc, tl, tr, tl-find, br; without one it stands at the bottom left over a fade. head may hold
